title: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem
summary: The separable quotient problem asks whether every infinite-dimensional Banach space has a separable infinite-dimensional quotient. We prove that this statement is independent of ZFC, relative to the consistency of ZFC with a measurable cardinal. This holds over both the real and complex fields. For spaces of norm density ℵ 1 , we obtain independence relative to the consistency of ZFC alone.
family_title: Independence of the separable quotient problem

review.reason: Proves independence of the separable quotient problem from ZFC for Banach spaces.
